title: Types of Borrowing - Silver Oak Capital
h1: Not revealed by search results. Search-result title tag reads "Types of Borrowing - Silver Oak Capital" [a][b].
summary: Older overview page (search tool reports its cached copy is roughly 1,600 days old, i.e. circa 2022) grouping Silver Oak Capital's lending into three blocks. (1) Development finance: senior, stretched senior, mezzanine / 2nd charge and joint venture equity, typical broker fee 1% of the loan, with a worked example of a GBP 10m loan at 6.5% fixed over 18 months at 75% loan-to-GDV. (2) Bridging finance: bridge to purchase, bridge to sell, equity release, 2nd charge and refinance; typical broker fee 1%, or 1.5% for loans outside the UK; quick to arrange, no affordability assessment, interest paid as a lump sum at end of term. (3) Other: high net worth / prime residential mortgages (seed: GBP 5m and above, policies vary by private bank branch, 1.00% fee), wealth management ("We can help with your wealth management.") and marine finance for superyacht purchases. No raw page text, H1, meta description, CTA, process steps or FAQ were surfaced; everything comes from search-engine summaries plus the seed file.

notes: Source quality: no raw page text was obtained; [a] and [b] are the search tool's summaries of a cached copy it describes as ~1,600 days old; [c] returned nothing from the page itself (only an odoo.com blog by the firm and unrelated generic bridging guides, all ignored except the one odoo sentence quoted). Contradictions / tensions: (1) [a] says the page mentions 'high net worth mortgages' while the seed records 'prime residential mortgages (GBP 5m and above)' for the same page - likely the same section paraphrased differently, not confirmed. (2) '2nd charge' is listed under both development finance (mezzanine/2nd charge) and bridging finance on the page [a][b]; [b]'s own commentary says second charge 'appears mainly under development finance', which is inconsistent with its listing it as a bridging variant. (3) Fee figures on this old page (1% / 1.5%) differ from the seed's blog-derived figure (~GBP 1,500 application + 0.5% at offer + 0.5% at completion) and from the Ts&Cs (client-specific fee agreement) - cross-page, time-separated claims. (4) Seed loan-size claims vary across pages (over GBP 500k, GBP 500k-20m, GBP 2m-20m, GBP 5m+ prime residential); only the GBP 5m+ prime residential figure is attributed to this page. Unrelated firms excluded: silveroakcp.com (Silver Oak Capital Partners), silveroakfunding.com, sofunding.net, syob.net listing, Silver Point / Sweet Oak Bloomberg items, Australian 'Assetline' guides, finbri, mt-finance, etc.
